name: LeadMagic
description: B2B data enrichment — email finder, validation, mobile numbers, profiles, company intelligence, jobs, ads, and search.

methods.label: Find Email
methods.description: Find a person's work email from their name and company. Needs a name (first_name+last_name OR full_name) AND a company (domain OR company_name). Returns { email, status, employment_verified, company_name }. 1 credit per valid email; free if not found.

methods.label: Validate Email
methods.description: Validate an email address and return deliverability + company data. Returns { email, email_status, is_domain_catch_all, company_name, company_industry }. 0.25 credit for definitive valid/invalid.

methods.label: Find Mobile
methods.description: Find a person's mobile phone number. Provide at least one of profile_url, work_email, personal_email. Returns { mobile_number, profile_url, email }. 5 credits on success; free if none found.

methods.label: Enrich LinkedIn Profile
methods.description: Enrich a LinkedIn profile from its URL. Returns { full_name, professional_title, bio, location, company_name, company_industry, work_experience[], education[] }. 1 credit on success.

extended_response.description: Include profile image URL in the response (default false)

methods.label: Email to LinkedIn Profile
methods.description: Reverse-lookup a LinkedIn profile from a work or personal email. Returns { profile_url }. 10 credits on success; free if no match.

methods.label: LinkedIn Profile to Work Email
methods.description: Reverse of b2bProfile: get a person's verified work email from their LinkedIn/B2B profile URL. Returns { email, profile_url, credits_consumed, message }. 5 credits on success; free if no result.

profile_url.description: LinkedIn/B2B profile URL or username, e.g. 'linkedin.com/in/johndoe'

methods.label: Find Personal Email
methods.description: Find a person's personal email(s) (Gmail/Outlook/iCloud) from their LinkedIn/B2B profile URL. Returns { profile_url, first_personal_email, personal_emails[], name, credits_consumed, message }. 2 credits if found; free if none.

methods.label: Enrich Company (V1)
methods.description: Legacy single-company enrichment from domain, name, or LinkedIn URL. Prefer companySearchV3 for new workflows. Returns firmographics, funding, and social metrics. 1 credit on success.

methods.label: Company Funding
methods.description: Get a company's funding history, financials, investors and CEO details. Provide company_domain (preferred) OR company_name. Returns { company_name, total_funding, latest_round, latest_round_amount, latest_round_date, funding_rounds[], investors[], lead_investors[], leadership.ceo{ firstName, lastName, designation, b2b_profile }, credits_consumed, message }. 4 credits on success; free if no funding data.

methods.label: Find Person by Role
methods.description: Find a person holding a given job title at a company. Requires job_title AND (company_domain OR company_name). Partial title match supported. Returns { first_name, last_name, full_name, job_title, company_name, company_website, profile_url, credits_consumed, message }. 2 credits if found; free if no match.

job_title.description: Target job title (partial match), e.g. 'VP of Sales'

methods.label: Find Company Employees
methods.description: List employees at a company. Requires company_domain OR company_name; optional limit (default 10). Returns { employees[]{ first_name, last_name, full_name, job_title, location, profile_url }, total_count, credits_consumed, message }. 0.05 credit per employee returned; free when none found.

methods.label: Detect Job Change
methods.description: Check whether a person has changed jobs from a known company. Provide profile_url plus the expected company_domain OR company_name. Returns { job_changed, still_employed, current_company, current_title }. 3 credits per call.

methods.label: Search Job Postings
methods.description: Search live job postings with company, role, location and date filters (intent/hiring signal). All params optional. Returns { total_count, page, per_page, total_pages, credits_consumed, results[]{ title, company info, location, types, experience level, remote status, publish date, description, application URL } }. 1 credit per job returned. Use jobCountries/jobTypes to resolve filter IDs first.

job_description.description: Filter by text in job description

experience_level.description: One of: entry, mid, senior, executive

posted_within.description: Jobs posted within the last N days

methods.label: List Job Countries
methods.description: List supported country filter IDs for jobsFinder. No inputs. Returns an array of { id, name }. Free — cache locally.

methods.label: List Job Types
methods.description: List supported job_type_id values for jobsFinder (e.g. Full Time=1, Part Time=2, Temporary=3, Internship=4, Freelance=5, Contract=6). No inputs. Returns an array of { id, name }. Free — cache locally.

methods.label: Search Google Ads
methods.description: Find a company's active Google Ads creatives. Requires company_domain (preferred) OR company_name. Returns { ads_count, ads[], credits_consumed, message }. 1 credit per ad returned; free if no ads found.

methods.label: Search Meta Ads
methods.description: Find a company's active Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ads from the Ad Library. Requires company_domain OR company_name. Returns { ads_count, ads[], credits_consumed, message }. 1 credit per ad returned; free if no ads found.

methods.label: Search B2B (LinkedIn) Ads
methods.description: Find a company's B2B / LinkedIn ad creatives. Requires company_domain OR company_name. Returns { ads_count, ads[], credits_consumed, message }. Charged 1 base credit plus 1 credit per ad returned (minimum 1). Use b2bAdDetails for full creative copy.

methods.label: Get B2B Ad Details
methods.description: Resolve full creative detail for a single B2B ad returned by b2bAdsSearch. Requires ad_url (the Ad Library URL or ID). Returns { ad_details{ ads_type, content, heading, cta{ title, url } }, credits_consumed, message }. 2 credits per resolved ad; free if not found.

ad_url.description: Ad Library URL or ID (from b2bAdsSearch results)

methods.label: Check Credits
methods.description: Get the current LeadMagic credit balance. Returns { credits }. Free.

methods.label: Analytics Dashboard
methods.description: Free account snapshot: credit balance, rate-limit utilization, concurrency metrics, and request/credit usage for today, this week, and this month. Returns { user, credits, rate_limit, concurrency, stats }. GET, no parameters.

methods.label: Find Lookalike Companies
methods.description: Find companies similar to a seed for ICP expansion. Provide one seed: company_domain, domain, website, company_name, or description. Optional company_filters, limit (1–2000, default 25), offset, and preview=true for a free count-only run. Returns { companies[], count, credits_consumed, message }. 1 credit per lookalike returned; free when preview=true or no matches.

company_domain.description: Seed company domain, e.g. 'stripe.com' (preferred seed input; alias of 'domain')

website.description: Seed company full URL or bare domain

description.description: Free-text semantic seed describing the target company profile

company_filters.description: Optional filters: geography, headcount, industry, tech stack, funding criteria

preview.description: If true, returns count only and spends no credits

methods.label: Search Companies (V3)
methods.description: Canonical company discovery: single-company lookup (provide one of company_domain / website / company_name / linkedin_url) OR criteria-based discovery via company_filters (industries, country_codes, headcount/revenue/funding ranges, technographics, founded-year range). Supports limit/offset pagination and a preview flag that returns match counts without spending credits. Direct lookup returns { found, company, companyName, companyDomain, websiteUrl, linkedinUrl }; broad search returns { companies[] } with firmographics, HQ location, funding/investors, social metrics, contact coverage, technographics, SIC/NAICS classifications. 1 credit per company returned; free when zero matches or when preview=true.

company_domain.description: Company domain for single-company lookup, e.g. 'stripe.com' (one of company_domain/website/company_name/linkedin_url)

website.description: Company website URL for single-company lookup (alternative lookup key)

company_name.description: Company name for single-company lookup (alternative lookup key)

linkedin_url.description: Company LinkedIn profile URL for single-company lookup (alternative lookup key)

company_filters.description: Criteria-based discovery filters: company_domains (string[]), country_codes (string[]), industries (string[]), headcount_ranges (array), crm_tech/marketing_tech/analytics_tech (technographics), founded_year_min/founded_year_max (int), revenue_ranges (array), funding_stages (array)

preview.description: If true, returns match counts without spending credits

methods.label: Find Competitors
methods.description: Find a company's competitors from a company identifier. Provide at least one of company_domain, company_url, or company_name. Returns { company_name, competitors[] (name, domain, profile_url, industry, employee_count, description), credits_consumed, message }. 5 credits per successful search; free if no competitors found.

company_domain.description: Company website domain, e.g. 'salesforce.com' (provide one of company_domain/company_url/company_name)

methods.label: Get Technographics
methods.description: Analyze a company's website to detect its technology stack (marketing, analytics, hosting, CRM, CDN, etc.) from a company_domain. Returns { company_domain, technologies (name/category/website/icon), categories (grouped by type), credits_consumed, message }. 1 credit per company if technologies are found; free if no results.

company_domain.description: Company website domain to analyze, e.g. 'stripe.com'

methods.label: People Search
methods.description: V3 people discovery at a company or across filters. Provide a company identifier (company_domain, company_name, or linkedin_url) or company_filters, plus optional title/job filters and people_filters. Returns { people[], count, returned_count, credits_consumed }. 1 credit per person returned; optional include_contact_details unlocks emails/mobiles for extra credits when confirm_credit_charge is true.

company_domain.description: Company website domain to target, e.g. 'stripe.com'. One company identifier required.

company_name.description: Company name to target. Alternative company identifier.

linkedin_url.description: Company LinkedIn URL to target. Alternative company identifier.

company_filters.description: Object of company-level filters for broad multi-company discovery; usable in place of a single company identifier.

people_filters.description: Nested object of people-level filters: full/first/last name, email domain, LinkedIn URL/username, job title, function, level, location (country, region, city, state), LinkedIn headline/about, industry, job description, languages, follower ranges, seniority score, email/mobile availability flags.

required_email.description: Only return people with an available email.

required_mobile.description: Only return people with an available mobile.

include_contact_details.description: Unlock raw contact details (emails/mobiles); incurs extra credits per unlock.

confirm_credit_charge.description: Required to confirm paid contact-detail unlocks when include_contact_details is true.

limit.description: Max people to return; max 100, default 25.

include_company.description: Include nested company data in each result.

methods.label: Job Company Types
methods.description: Catalog of company type classifications (e.g. public, private, nonprofit) used to filter Jobs Finder results via the company_type_id parameter. Returns the list of { id, name } company types. Free helper endpoint — cache results locally; no credits charged. Takes no input.

methods.label: List Job Industries
methods.description: Catalog endpoint returning the list of job/company industry categories and their IDs. Use the returned company_industry_id to filter the Jobs Finder and other targeting endpoints. Takes no parameters; returns an array of { id, name } industry records. Free helper endpoint — no credits charged; cache results locally.

methods.label: Job Regions
methods.description: List supported regions/states for job-search geographic targeting. Free catalog endpoint, no inputs. Returns an array of { id, name, country_id }; use the returned region id as region_id in the Jobs Finder API and pair with country_id for precise targeting.

methods.label: Search Jobs
methods.description: Search live job postings with structured filters. All filters optional; set autoResolve to map friendly names/domains to filter IDs. Returns { signals[], total, pagination.next_cursor, credits_consumed }. 1 credit per job returned; free if none returned; dryRun validates without charging.

titles.description: Title filter: { include: string[], exclude: string[], vector: boolean (semantic title matching) }

occupationTaxonomy.description: Normalized occupation filter: { level1, level2, level3 } each string[] or int[] (broad family / mid-level / specific title)

companies.description: Company filter: { include: string[] (domains or names), exclude: string[], ids: int[] (exact company IDs) }

location.description: Location filter: { countries, regions, states, cities } each string[] or int[] (names, codes, or IDs)

tags.description: Tag filter: { include, exclude } each string[] or int[] (tag names or IDs)

salary.description: Normalized USD salary filter: { min_usd: integer, max_usd: integer }

seniority.description: Experience levels: EN, MI, SE, EX

postedAfter.description: YYYY-MM-DD; jobs posted on/after this date

postedBefore.description: YYYY-MM-DD; jobs posted before/on this date

postedWithin.description: Jobs posted within the last N days

pagination.description: Cursor object from a prior response's pagination.next_cursor

includeDescription.description: Include job description snippet in results

includeOccupationTaxonomy.description: Include occupation taxonomy fields in results

dryRun.description: Validate the query without charging credits

autoResolve.description: Resolve friendly strings (domains, names) into filter IDs before search

methods.label: Job Search Catalogs
methods.description: Catalog/helper endpoint returning all job-search filter taxonomies in one call: countries, regions, job_types, industries, company_types, seniority levels, and dataset stats. Takes no parameters. Use to populate static filter dropdowns. Free; 0 credits.

methods.label: Job Search Companies
methods.description: Resolve a free-text company name or domain into canonical company IDs for use as Job Search filters (autocomplete/filter-builder helper). Pass q (name or domain) and/or domain (exact). Returns { companies: [{ id, name, domain, logo_domain }] }. Free, 0 credits.

q.description: Free-text company name or domain to search for, e.g. 'leadmagic'

limit.description: Max number of company candidates to return

methods.label: Resolve Job Search Filters
methods.description: Resolve friendly job-search filter values (company names/domains, tags, titles, occupation taxonomy, locations) into canonical LeadMagic filter IDs before running a job search. POST body groups inputs by filter category, each with include/exclude sub-arrays. Returns each input value replaced by { id, name, ... } canonical objects, plus a `warnings` array for any unresolved values. Free helper endpoint. Companion GET autocomplete helpers (all also free, /v3/jobs/search/{companies,tags,titles,occupation-taxonomy,locations,catalogs}?q=) provide per-field lookups.

companies.description: Company filters to resolve: { include, exclude, ids } (names or domains, e.g. 'leadmagic.io')

tags.description: Tag filters to resolve: { include, exclude }

occupationTaxonomy.description: Occupation taxonomy filters to resolve: { level1, level2, level3 }

location.description: Location filters to resolve: { countries, regions, states, cities }

titles.description: Job title filters to resolve: { include, exclude }

methods.label: Job Search Locations
methods.description: Resolve a free-text location query into canonical location IDs for job-search geo filtering. Requires q (e.g. 'Berlin', 'United') AND type (one of country/region/state/city). Returns { locations: [{ id, name, type }] }. Free helper/catalog endpoint, 0 credits.

type.description: Location type to search. One of 'country', 'region', 'state', or 'city'

limit.description: Max number of location candidates to return (optional)

methods.label: Job Search Occupation Taxonomy
methods.description: Autocomplete occupation taxonomy: maps free-text occupation input to standardized IDs/labels across a 3-tier hierarchy (level1 families, level2 categories, level3 normalized titles). Requires q (search query); optional level filter and limit. Returns { occupation_taxonomy: [{ id, name, type, level1, level2, level3, path }], credits_consumed: 0 }. Free (0 credits).

level.description: Optional. Filter by taxonomy level: 'level1', 'level2', or 'level3'

limit.description: Optional. Number of results to return

methods.label: Job Search Tags
methods.description: Tag autocomplete for the Job Search filter builder. Free-text query `q` returns normalized hiring-signal tags (tools/platforms/skills, e.g. kubernetes, terraform, react); optionally scope by tag_type_id and cap with limit. Returns { tags: [{ id, name, tag_type, occupation_taxonomy }] }. Free (0 credits).

tag_type_id.description: Optional tag-type ID to scope the search

limit.description: Number of tag candidates to return

methods.label: Job Search Titles
methods.description: Title autocomplete + occupation taxonomy helper for the Job Search filters. Takes a free-text title query `q` (and optional `limit`); returns { titles: [{ id, name, occupation_taxonomy }] } with hierarchical taxonomy metadata. Use to resolve title filters before running a Job Search. Free / 0 credits.

limit.description: Max number of title candidates to return (optional)

methods.label: Search Stats
methods.description: Free helper summarizing coverage and capabilities for Jobs, Company, and People Search. Requires products[] (jobs|company|people) and sections[] (coverage|top|capabilities); optional limit (default 3, max 25). Returns cached metrics for filter builders and onboarding UIs. 0 credits.

limit.description: Optional. Number of top values per dimension (default 3, max 25)
